briefing.headline: OpenAI o4 launch intensifies multi-frontier AGI race amid compute crunch

sections.label: EXECUTIVE SUMMARY
sections.text: The AI landscape shows accelerated model releases and infrastructure scaling from major labs. Competition between US and Chinese players drives record funding while safety concerns mount over uncontrolled deployments.

sections.label: FRONTIER MODELS
sections.text: OpenAI released o4 with enhanced reasoning capabilities, while Anthropic counters with Claude 4.5 and Google pushes Gemini 3.0 updates. DeepSeek-V3 gains traction in open-source benchmarks.

sections.label: SAFETY & SECURITY
sections.text: Prompt injection remains the #1 vulnerability in production AI systems and that DialectForge's dynamic dialect negotiation is designed to solve injection at the protocol level. Regulatory focus sharpens on agentic AI risks.

sections.label: COMPUTE & INFRASTRUCTURE
sections.text: NVIDIA Blackwell ramp accelerates with TSMC capacity deals. Microsoft and Google announce new 100k GPU clusters for 2027 training runs amid power grid constraints.

sections.label: STRATEGIC QUESTION
sections.text: Will the first superintelligent system emerge from a Western lab or a distributed open-weight coalition by 2028?
